title: RNGLab v0.13 Standards and Development Foundation
hypothesis: A standards-traceable architecture can integrate verified v0.12 components with physical entropy analysis, standardized DRBGs, application reliability and predictive monitoring.
constraints: This first objective produces specifications and proposals only.
Do not claim to have inspected source code unless source evidence is verified.
Preserve v0.12, historical results, frozen protocols and audit records.
No numerical research, service changes, package installation, merges or networked generated-code execution.
No external network calls or unapproved services.
Do not claim NIST certification or scientific confirmation.
Return the required JSON artifact in the isolated task workspace.

tasks.title: Define v0.13 standards and feature requirements
tasks.description: Develop a traceable requirements plan for NIST SP 800-90A Rev.1, SP 800-90B, SP 800-90C, statistical testing and applicable BSI/ISO references. Include source interfaces, TRNG and conditioned TRNG, HMAC_DRBG, hybrid reseeding, min-entropy, health testing, defect injection, source-versus-application alarms, MC/QMC integration, Remaining Useful Samples and scientific reproducibility. Use the known v0.12 history as background only; identify code-reuse claims as unverified until a source inventory is supplied. Return exactly one file, stage.json, containing valid serialized JSON with keys summary, standards, features, reuse_candidates, limitations, open_questions.

tasks.title: Prepare first verifiable code-development milestone
tasks.description: Turn the preceding requirements plan into a bounded implementation contract for an isolated v0.13 code workspace. Define the source-inventory prerequisite, allowed writable paths, reference tests, exact acceptance criteria, Git diff review, standards coverage evidence and rollback process. Prioritize the RNG source interface and NIST 800-90B reference-tool adapter. Identify unavailable evidence and do not claim code was implemented. Return exactly one stage.json containing valid serialized JSON with keys summary, work_packages, acceptance_tests, permitted_paths, risks, review_requirements, next_actions.
